title: A fingerprint ignores only line endings, trailing whitespace, trailing blank lines and a BOM
assertion: A file's fingerprint stays the same when only its line endings (CRLF or CR), trailing whitespace on any line, trailing blank lines, a missing final newline or a leading byte-order mark differ, for text and bytes alike, and changes for any other edit, including indentation, tabs for spaces, and blank or deleted lines inside the text.

origin.text: Phase 1 behaviour, reviewed by Gemini in 3 rounds and strengthened after SeamSpec's reviewer explained two drafts (ADR-20261120-9495); proposed for the owner to approve.
